Title: Public preview: Measure product effectiveness with new user analytics experience in Application Insights

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor Application Insights is a cloud native application monitoring offering which enables you to observe failures, bottlenecks, and usage patterns to improve application performance and effectiveness.

The new HEART Workbook is based on Google's HEART framework and enables powerful user analytics in a single, cohesive real user monitoring (RUM) experience. It provides key insights into user behaviors across your entire product and enables feature-level drilldowns for a holistic end-to-end view. The workbook is built on the JavaScript Click Analytics Auto-Collection Plugin, released earlier this year.

Learn more.
